title: Led by Brock Purdy's 3-TD night, 49ers remind NFL that Rams, Seahawks are no sure bet

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Led by Brock Purdy's 3-TD night, 49ers remind NFL that Rams, Seahawks are no sure bet
sources.description: The Niners showed the NFL this week that their talent and coaching staff threaten their fellow division mates and Super Bowl darlings: the Rams and the Seahawks.
